findings.text: Prior Martínez locator defect is corrected: the score-validation sentence is introduction/journal p. 584; the distinct approximately 48th-percentile passers sentence remains discussion/journal p. 598.
All five dynamic HTML captures reproduced exact raw-to-semantic identities and extents.
Pinned Katz tree reproduced the 78-body manifest: 72 UTF-8 searched bodies and six binary no-text records.

limitations: Fresh automated retrieval of the Texas A&M PDF may return HTTP 403; exact independently retained institutional VOR bytes, title, DOI, edition, digest, seven spans, and printed pages were revalidated.
Bounded Git and web searches do not prove that no inaccessible launch-time analysis existed.
Mirrors, derivatives, and shared method, material, author, citation, or derivation lineage receive no extra independence credit.
Historical GPT-4 exam results do not establish current-model performance or practicing-lawyer quality.
